purpose: Changed-input provisional-target sensitivity; separate from the clean-pin reproduction and not a full manifest run.
post_run_adaptations: Updated interpretation strings to name the 24 selected cases and the nine provisional eligibility assumptions; added names for existing median imputations and explicit one-plus-nine counts. No numerical fit, propensity, pool or stress values changed. Subsequent source-audit wording, loader reason, input line ending normalisation and review metadata changes preserve the same sampler inputs; the patch records the exact run state.

diagnostics.ess: The run producer recorded R-hat and divergences but did not save ESS.

independent_input_comparison.result: All sample arrays, target keys and sizes, unavailable and selected unresolved keys, pseudo-reserve, HHI, year and regime arrays match exactly between the run snapshot and the current implementation.

input_patch_recovery: Decompress the gzip file byte for byte, then apply to a clean checkout of the base commit with git apply --ignore-whitespace <decompressed-patch-path>. The patch has CRLF context, so plain git apply may fail on an LF checkout.
